blocks.text: When it comes to heating repair in Cibolo, TX, you can trust the experts at Rosenberg Plumbing & Air. You rely on a functional heating system, especially when the weather is extreme. Trust us to keep you and your family warm and comfortable all year.

Your home’s heater can last long if you service it well. But, it can still break down due to issues like a faulty compressor, a defective capacitor, or a broken thermostat. Most of these issues result from ice and debris, which may clog your system’s coils and alter the heater’s normal operations.

Ensure that your heating equipment operates during the coldest months to avoid complications. Scheduling a furnace repair before the cold season arrives will help to prevent furnace issues during the winter.

Heat pumps and furnaces are reliable energy sources, but they may experience repair problems. Sometimes, your furnace won’t turn on because of a broken compressor or a refrigerant leak. Also, if your heating equipment blows cold air, it may be in defrost mode, or its air filter might have dirt. The heater may struggle to blow hot air due to physical blockages that reduce system performance and airflow.

If your furnace produces strange smells, you should reach out to HVAC technicians to repair your unit. A heating unit can also consume too much energy when producing hot air, and this will negatively impact your electricity bills. It’s also a sign that you should act promptly to repair your equipment.

Many homeowners ask technicians whether they should service or upgrade their furnaces. We understand that sometimes your unit needs replacement instead of repair. Determining whether the unit breaks down regularly or occasionally is advisable. If the heater breaks down regularly, you can replace it rather than spending a lot of money on frequent repairs.
